title: E-document payment improvements
summary: E-Document payment processing now supports durable, retryable occurrences with bounded automatic retries, dispatcher job management, and enhanced French E-Reporting UI for lifecycle messages.
key_points: Captures payment applications and reversals for outgoing sales-invoice E-Documents
Installs recurring dispatcher processing occurrences in batches with 30-minute processing lease protection
Implements bounded retries with delays of 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours, and 8 hours; Action Required status after five failures
Adds UI for lifecycle messages, VAT breakdowns, payment occurrences, and retry details in French E-Reporting
Migrates existing error occurrences to Retry Pending during install and upgrade
quote: Captures payment applications and reversals for outgoing sales-invoice E-Documents and publishes them through the payment-occurrence integration event.
